name: Wood Spirit
body:
School conjuration (summoning) [wood]; Level bloodlord 1, druid 1, shaman 1

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, M (a splinter of wood covered in blood)

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Effect one nature servant

Duration 1 hour/level

Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

Wood: Spells with this descriptor include those that directly create, utilize, or manipulate plant or wood in some manner or conjure creatures with the plant subtype or composed of wood. Such spells are considered to belong to the Wood element (for geomancers) and the Wood elemental school (for wood elementalists).

You summon up a minor wood spirit to aid you. The spirit’s appearance is up to the caster. It can perform minor natural tasks like gathering herbs or food, setting up camp, feeding animals.

The spirit continues to do the same action unless directed to do otherwise if the task is complete. It only has an effective Strength of 2 and weighs only 20 pounds. It has a speed of 15 feet, and a fly speed of 15 feet (perfect).

The wood spirit has no ability to attack or perform offensive actions. It cannot make attack rolls or saving throws, if it takes damage equal to your caster level, it dissipates. It also dissipates if it moves beyond the spell’s range.
